about_the_game:
In Asvara, you awaken in a world where sound itself has vanished. The corridors hum without noise, the machines breathe without voices, and something watches you from the silence. Nothing explains itself. Nothing makes sense. Yet everything feels alive.

Wander through shifting rooms and fractured memories. Decode strange symbols. Listen to the silence — it hides things you cannot see.

What is Asvara? A dream? A machine? A parasite? The only way to understand is to descend deeper… even if what you find cannot be forgotten.

Features

  • Uncanny Atmosphere: Explore surreal environments built to disturb more than frighten.

  • Glitch Horror: Reality bends, fragments, and rewrites itself.

  • AI-Driven Encounters: Something is there, but it doesn’t follow human rules.

  • Psychological Unease: Short, intense play sessions designed to leave you questioning what you experienced.

  • Replayable Mystery: Every return trip offers new fragments and altered details.
